“In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a
disability related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this
meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk’s office at
310-952-1720 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.” (Government Code Section
54954.2)
PUBLIC INFORMATION

The public may address the members of the City Council on any matters within the
jurisdiction of the City Council or on any items on the agenda of the City Council
during the designated public comment period. Because of the threat of COVID-19
(the “Coronavirus”) you are urged to take all appropriate health safety precautions.

Due to COVID-19 protocols, City Council Chambers is set at a limited capacity (18
persons) with 100 persons allowed at the Community Center.

All staff and members of the public will be required to wear a mask before entering
and while inside City Hall or the Carson Community Center, a temperature check will
be enforced, proof of vaccination and/or a recent COVID-19 test within 3 days of the
City Council Meeting will be required. A staff member will ask a series of COVID-19
symptom questions before you will be cleared to enter either facility to participate in
the meeting. Should the City Council Chamber exceed the set capacity, members of
the public including speakers providing public comments will be directed to the
Community Center for participation in the City Council Meeting.

For members of the public who do not have proof of full vaccination or a COVID-19
test within 3 days of the City Council Meeting, Northshore Clinical Labs can provide
a PCR/Rapid COVID-Test.  Their hours on regular City Council meeting days are
from 10:30 am – 8:00 pm. They are located in the Carson Sheriff’s Station public
parking lot across the street from City Hall. There is no cost for the Rapid test.

CITY OF CARSON  Page 1

TO FACILITATE PUBLIC VIEWING, OUR CARSON CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS WILL
BE AVAILABLE TO YOU BY:

- Livestream on the City’s website: The meeting will be streamed live over the
internet via www.carsonca.gov.

- Cable Channel 35 (Spectrum) and Channel 99 (AT&T)

- YOUTUBE: https://youtu.be/WxKOS-aum18

The Oral Communications portion of the agenda is limited to a duration of one hour
unless otherwise approved by the City Council. While participating, please state
your name and identify the agenda item, as applicable, that you wish to address in
your comments.

In lieu of providing your public comment live/in-person at the City Hall or Community
Center on the day of the Meeting, public comments will be accepted by the City
through the following 3 methods up until two hours prior to the meeting’s published
start time on the date of the meeting. Comments received will be circulated to the
City Council and incorporated into the record. All public comments regardless of
how they are submitted should indicate the Agenda item you wish to address. If your
public comment is for a matter not listed on the agenda, please indicate that also.
Public comments can be submitted prior to the Meeting through the following ways:

- Email: you can email public comments to cityclerk@carsonca.gov or through the
homepage of our City website at www.carsonca.gov.

- Telephone: you can record your comments at 310-952-1720.

- Box Outside of City Hall: you can provide public comments written on paper by
dropping them off at the box located in front of City Hall (701 East Carson Street.
Carson, CA 90745).

PUBLIC INFORMATION

The public may address the members of the City Council on any matters within the jurisdiction of the City Council or on any items on the agenda of the City Council during the designated public comment period. Because of the threat of COVID-19 (the “Coronavirus”) you are urged to take all appropriate health safety precautions.

Due to COVID-19 protocols, City Council Chambers is set at a limited capacity (18 persons) with 100 persons allowed at the Community Center.

All staff and members of the public will be required to wear a mask before entering and while inside City Hall or the Carson Community Center, a temperature check will be enforced, proof of vaccination and/or a recent COVID-19 test within 3 days of the City Council Meeting will be required.  A staff member will ask a series of COVID-19 symptom questions before you will be cleared to enter either facility to participate in the meeting. Should the City Council Chamber exceed the set capacity, members of the public including speakers providing public comments will be directed to the Community Center for participation in the City Council Meeting.

For members of the public who do not have proof of full vaccination or a COVID-19 test within 3 days of the City Council Meeting, Northshore Clinical Labs can provide a PCR/Rapid COVID-Test.  Their hours on regular City Council meeting days are from 10:30 am – 8:00 pm. They are located in the Carson Sheriff’s Station public parking lot across the street from City Hall. There is no cost for the Rapid test.

TO FACILITATE PUBLIC VIEWING, OUR CARSON CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS WILL BE AVAILABLE TO YOU BY:

- Livestream on the City’s website: The meeting will be streamed live over the internet via www.carsonca.gov.

- Cable Channel 35 (Spectrum) and Channel 99 (AT&T)

- YOUTUBE: https://youtu.be/WxKOS-aum18

The Oral Communications portion of the agenda is limited to a duration of one hour unless otherwise approved by the City Council. While participating, please state your name and identify the agenda item, as applicable, that you wish to address in your comments.

In lieu of providing your public comment live/in-person at the City Hall or Community Center on the day of the Meeting, public comments will be accepted by the City through the following 3 methods up until two hours prior to the meeting’s published start time on the date of the meeting. Comments received will be circulated to the City Council and incorporated into the record. All public comments regardless of how they are submitted should indicate the Agenda item you wish to address. If your public comment is for a matter not listed on the agenda, please indicate that also. Public comments can be submitted prior to the Meeting through the following ways:

- Email: you can email public comments to cityclerk@carsonca.gov or through the homepage of our City website at www.carsonca.gov.

- Telephone: you can record your comments at 310-952-1720.  

- Box Outside of City Hall: you can provide public comments written on paper by dropping them off at the box located in front of City Hall (701 East Carson Street. Carson, CA 90745).
